summary.text: Spencer Sherman is a Republican candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Chittenden-19 District, in the November 3, 2026 general election, and is listed by Ballotpedia as vice chair of the Libertarian Party of Vermont.

paragraphs.text: Sherman ran for the same Chittenden-19 seat in 2022 as a Libertarian and finished third in the general election with 628 votes, or 11.6 percent.
He ran again in 2024, listed as a Libertarian and Republican candidate, and received 934 votes, or 11.0 percent, finishing fourth in a race for two seats.
In the August 11, 2026 Republican primary he advanced as a write-in candidate with 27 votes.
